reasoning: This task involves implementing a UI/UX feedback loop system inspired by the Agentation approach. It requires integrating visual UI annotation with automatic task/spec generation, MCP integration for two-way dialogue, and cross-service coordination between the Electron frontend and backend spec creation system. Multiple unfamiliar technologies and new architectural patterns are involved.

scope.notes: Affects Electron frontend (UI annotation layer), backend (spec/task creation), and MCP integration layer. Will require new components, new MCP tools, and integration with existing spec creation pipeline.

integrations.notes: Need to research Agentation library for React, understand its API, or implement similar functionality. MCP integration for real-time feedback loop requires understanding Model Context Protocol patterns.

infrastructure.notes: Will need new env vars to enable/disable UI feedback feature. No database or Docker changes since this is a development-time feature integrated into existing Electron app.

knowledge.notes: No existing UI annotation or visual feedback patterns in the codebase. The concept of mapping visual UI elements to code locations is new. Existing MCP infrastructure can be extended.

concerns: UI annotation accuracy (CSS selectors must correctly identify elements)
Integration with existing spec creation workflow
Performance impact of annotation overlay on running prototype
User experience of the feedback mechanism itself
risk.notes: Feature is additive and optional, so risk to existing functionality is low. Main risks are around implementation complexity and UX quality of the feedback mechanism.
